# Data Integrity Checklist: G56R-003 Evaluation Runner, Fixtures, Scoring, and Statistical Analysis

**Purpose**: Validate requirement quality for immutable evidence joins, stable identifiers, versioned hashes, partition isolation, sanitized committed evidence, and additive invalidation.
**Created**: 2026-07-25
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. It tests requirements quality, not implementation behavior.

## Immutable Evidence Graph

- [x] CHK001 Does the spec require G56R-002 artifacts, identifiers, and zero-set evidence to remain immutable while G56R-003 publishes only additive successor artifacts? [Completeness, Spec FR-001, Spec SC-001]
- [x] CHK002 Does the plan define the full source-ledger-to-decision data flow with every handoff represented as a required ID-and-digest join? [Completeness, Plan Immutable Data Flow]
- [x] CHK003 Does the data model define the append-only identifier graph from source snapshot and runtime catalog through freeze, assignment, execution trace, score bundle, analysis output, and decision bundle? [Traceability, Data Model Identifier Graph]
- [x] CHK004 Are downstream experiment, score, analysis, and decision bundles required to reference upstream artifacts rather than embed or mutate treatment traces? [Consistency, Spec FR-010, Plan Immutable Data Flow, Data Model Score Bundle]
- [x] CHK005 Is orphan prevention specified through parent ID/digest validation before child object construction? [Measurability, Data Model Identifier Graph, Data Model Comparison Set and Assignment]
- [x] CHK006 Are in-place mutation risks addressed by additive invalidation records and new versioned descendant objects? [Consistency, Spec FR-034, Plan Versioning and Additive Invalidation, Data Model Invalidation Record]
- [x] CHK007 Are lossy joins prevented by requiring both logical IDs and expected digests on references? [Clarity, Data Model Conventions, Contract binding definitions]

## Identifier And Version Quality

- [x] CHK008 Does the spec require stable route, trace, score, analysis-plan, and decision identifiers before they can be used for qualification decisions? [Completeness, Spec FR-010, Spec FR-032, Spec FR-037]
- [x] CHK009 Do the planned contracts require explicit `schema_version` fields for successor freeze, experiment policy, role corpus, score bundle, and decision bundle artifacts? [Completeness, Contracts]

- [x] CHK012 Are allowed null states distinguished from missing, unavailable, or undocumented evidence so nulls cannot silently satisfy treatment or scoring requirements? [Clarity, Spec Clarifications Session 2, Spec FR-009, Data Model Execution Trace]
- [x] CHK013 Are profile-only effective-treatment observations explicitly barred from becoming configured-route proof? [Boundary, Spec FR-030, Data Model Execution Trace]
- [x] CHK014 Do success criteria quantify the required completeness of treatment, score, decision, and sensitive-field validation outcomes? [Measurability, Spec SC-004, Spec SC-007, Spec SC-011, Spec SC-015]

## Capability And Route Binding

## Execution Trace And Score Bundles

- [x] CHK020 Does the spec require a new immutable G56R-003 `execution_trace_id` for every assigned attempt under the existing G56R-002 treatment contract? [Completeness, Spec FR-010, Data Model Execution Trace, G56R-002 treatment-record schema]

## Evidence Retention And Provenance

- [x] CHK030 Does the spec define a deny-by-default committed evidence allowlist and keep raw captures, account/auth material, credentials, headers, cookies, private hosts, absolute paths, repository remotes, prompts, responses, billing, plan data, and raw catalog bytes operator-only? [Completeness, Spec FR-027, Data Model Sensitive-Evidence Allowlist]
- [x] CHK031 Does the plan separate raw-byte owners, committed proofs, and operator-only retention for runtime catalog, agent policy, execution, scoring, and release evidence? [Clarity, Plan Evidence Boundaries]
- [x] CHK032 Are committed deterministic fixtures and replay artifacts required to contain only sanitized IDs, digests, relative repository bindings, anonymized ballots, sanitized rationales, and content-addressed evidence references? [Boundary, Spec FR-036, Quickstart Raw evidence retention]
- [x] CHK033 Are sensitive-field violations specified as blocking publication rather than relying on manual redaction? [Measurability, Spec FR-027, Plan Evidence Boundaries, Quickstart Raw evidence retention]
- [x] CHK034 Are scorer, ballot, adjudicator, rubric, fixture, and review provenance requirements complete enough to detect stale or identity-revealing scoring evidence? [Completeness, Spec FR-016, Spec FR-035, Data Model Semantic Ballot, Data Model Adjudication]

## Invalidation And Staleness

- [x] CHK035 Are source ledger, runtime catalog, client/build, identity boundary, normalization map, materializer, fixture, scorer, rubric, adjudicator, treatment contract, partition, experiment policy, and analysis-plan changes mapped to new artifacts and affected descendants? [Completeness, Plan Versioning and Additive Invalidation]
- [x] CHK036 Are invalidation reasons closed and scoped to the artifact family rather than free-form prose that could hide stale scorer or fixture versions? [Clarity, Spec FR-034, Data Model Invalidation Record, Contracts]
- [x] CHK037 Does the data model require stale artifacts to remain readable for audit while being barred from current decisions? [Boundary, Plan Versioning and Additive Invalidation, Data Model Invalidation Record]
- [x] CHK038 Are deterministic replay requirements strong enough to reconstruct identical terminal decisions from frozen experiment, score, analysis, and decision bundles on a clean checkout? [Measurability, Spec SC-011, Quickstart Replay frozen evidence]
